database.title: Miniflux
database.blurb: The schema behind Miniflux, a minimalist feed reader, rebuilt from the migration strings in its Go source: users and how they sign in, the feeds and categories they follow, the entries fetched for them, and a few system tables.

domains.title: Users and access
domains.blurb: Users, their browser and API sessions, API keys, passkeys, and per-user third-party integrations.

domains.title: Feeds
domains.blurb: Feeds and the categories that group them, plus the deduplicated icons feeds share.

domains.title: Entries
domains.blurb: Fetched entries, their enclosures, and the tombstones that keep a deleted entry from coming back.

domains.title: System
domains.blurb: Schema version, CSRF tokens, and the ACME certificate cache.

conventions: Every user-owned table carries user_id with ON DELETE CASCADE, so deleting a user takes their feeds and entries with it.
Timestamps are TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE.
